editorial.blurb: Bar Roma is a beloved neighborhood Italian destination celebrated for house-made pastas and signature meatballs, where Roman-inspired cuisine shines in an upscale-yet-welcoming atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or expect a wait—this local hot spot packs in quickly, especially on weekends. The complimentary bread is a nice opener while you decide between their pasta dishes and standout meatball appetizer.
